About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with exciting opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients range from startups and digital agencies to tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with a client, where you become an in-house member of their team and a valued contributor to their success.

Job SummaryÂ 

Weâre seeking an experienced Account Executive / High-Ticket Sales Closer with a strong track record of converting qualified opportunities into closed-won deals.

This remote sales role is ideal for a confident, commercially driven professional who can take ownership of the full closing process, from conducting discovery calls and product presentations to handling objections, negotiating terms, and confidently asking for the sale.

You should have at least 3 years of professional sales experience, including hands-on experience closing high-ticket deals. Experience selling within technology, SaaS, or a related B2B industry is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage qualified sales opportunities from initial discovery through negotiation and closing.
  • Lead effective discovery calls to understand prospectsâ needs, pain points, budgets, and purchasing motivations.
  • Deliver compelling sales presentations, product demos, and closing calls.
  • Demonstrate value and clearly communicate ROI to potential customers.
  • Confidently address objections related to pricing, timing, competitors, and decision-making.
  • Manage follow-ups and keep deals moving forward throughout the sales cycle.
  • Negotiate commercial terms and consistently drive opportunities toward closing.
  • Keep CRM records up to date, including pipeline, opportunities, and customer details.
  • Work closely with SDRs, marketing, customer success, and other internal teams.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual sales and revenue targets.
  • Identify ways to improve conversion rates and enhance overall sales performance.
  • At least 3 years of professional sales experience, preferably in an Account Executive, Sales Executive, Business Development, or Sales Closing role.
  • Proven experience closing high-ticket deals is essential.
  • A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong skills in discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing.
  • Excellent verbal and written English, with strong client-facing communication abilities.
  • Comfortable selling via video calls, phone, email, and other remote communication channels.
  • Experience managing sales pipelines and working with CRM platforms.
  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to communicate value beyond price.
  • Self-driven, accountable, and motivated to achieve ambitious revenue targets.
  • Experience in Tech, SaaS, software, or other B2B technology sectors is preferred.

Senior Software Engineer

Remote role based in Latin America. Must work at least 6 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time.

Â 

What We Do

Wagmo is a modern pet healthcare company built around how pet parents actually care for their pets. We partner with employers to provide a complete approach to pet and pet-parent wellbeing, from preventive wellness plans and emergency coverage to 24/7 pet telehealth guidance. Our purpose is to unlock every pet parent's potential to provide extraordinary care, and we do it by bringing the same intentionality to pet benefits that the best employers bring to human healthcare. Founded in 2017 and female-founded, Wagmo is headquartered in New York City and trusted by leading employers nationwide.

Â 

Whatâs Important To Us

Our mission shapes everything we build and how we work together. We take fearless ownership of outcomes, collaborate with radical candor, and are always driven by the customers and pet parents who trust us. We think critically, follow through relentlessly, and find the extra 10% that turns good work into exceptional work. We keep it weird because the obvious answer is rarely the most interesting one. Our values aren't aspirational. We interview for them and hold each other accountable to them. If what you've read so far resonates with you and you want to be part of a team where every person makes the company meaningfully better, we'd love to hear from you..

Â 

About The Role

Wagmo uses AI to process pet wellness and insurance claims. When it works, a pet parent submits a claim and gets reimbursed without anyone on our team touching it. We already automate a meaningful share of claims, and weâre hiring a Senior Software Engineer to take that much further.

Youâll join our Pet Parents squad and take on our claims automation system, the pipeline that reads invoices, decides whatâs covered, and pays claims. In your first year, youâll make it cheaper to run, easier to change, and able to handle claims it canât handle today. Youâll own that work from design to production and partner with Product on what to build next.

This role is for someone who has shipped AI features that real users and real money depend on, and who knows the difference between a demo and a system you can trust.

Â 

Our Tech Stack: Python Â· Django Â· TypeScript Â· React Â· LLM APIs Â· OpenRouter Â· LangSmith Â· GitHub Â· Linear Â· Claude Code Â· CodeRabbit

Â 

Core Responsibilities

  • Learn our claims automation pipeline in depth and become a core owner, reviewing and shipping changes on your own within your first few months.

  • Lower the cost of every claim we process by routing work to the right models, while keeping accuracy at or above where it is today.

  • Restructure the pipeline so each stage can be changed, tested, and rolled out independently, with evaluations gating every change.

  • Ship new automation that lets more claims resolve without manual review, working with Product to decide what comes next.

  • Use AI to read veterinary records and make better coverage decisions on more types of claims.

What Youâll Need To Be Successful

  • Youâve shipped an LLM-powered feature to production that real users or real money depend on. You set up evaluations before rollout, versioned your prompts and models, and planned for rollback.

  • Youâve designed or substantially refactored a system the business depends on, such as payments or claims, without breaking it, and left it easier to change than you found it.

  • Youâve taken over a complex system someone else built and become the person others trust with it. Your code reviews change designs, not just style.

  • Youâve made real tradeoffs between model cost and quality, and you can show the numbers that proved quality held.

  • You use coding agents and AI review tools every day, and theyâve changed how fast you ship without lowering the quality of your work.

  • Strong Python skills. Experience with Django and TypeScript is a plus.

Why Consider This Role?

  • Your work pays real claims to real pet parents. Youâll see the impact in production.

  • AI is the core of the product here, not a side project. Youâll own one of the most important systems at the company.

  • Youâll have real scope on a small team, making decisions a larger company would spread across several people.

  • Youâll help pet parents get reimbursed faster for the care their pets need.

Key Benefits

  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage

  • HSA/FSA

  • 401(k) retirement planning with employer matching

  • Unlimited paid time off

  • Annual company holidays

  • Additional company-wide recharge days off

  • 12 weeks parental leave for eligible employees

  • Company paid Wagmo pet wellness and insurance plans

  • Regular company-wide events and team gatherings

  • Pet-friendly office

  • Catered lunches

Â 

We here at Wagmo strive to build a workforce composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds, abilities, minds, and identities that will help us to grow, not only as a company, but also as individuals. Wagmo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Klardaten connects DATEV with other software and AI applications. Weâre hiring 1â2 senior engineers to own product development, DATEV integrations and automation.

Based in the EU Â· Remote or Berlin Â· Full time Â· Permanent or contract Â· Start as soon as possible

Own the outcome

Once we agree on a general goal, you independently work out what to build and how to deliver it. You investigate the problem, define the scope, make technical decisions and carry the work through implementation, testing, deployment and follow-up.

What you will do

  • Turn general product goals into clear requirements, a practical scope and technical decisions.
  • Build product features, DATEV integrations and automations across frontend and backend.
  • Own testing, deployment and ongoing improvement, including resolving problems in production.
  • Find answers, resolve blockers and keep the founders informed. Raise decisions that need discussion early.

Examples of goals

  • Make connecting a DATEV environment easier and reduce manual setup.
  • Give customers access to a new DATEV data area through our API and MCP server.
  • Turn a recurring manual workflow into a reliable automation that users can review.

What you bring

  • Strong production TypeScript experience across frontend and backend.
  • Experience independently shipping and maintaining software from a general goal, without detailed specifications, predefined tickets or day-to-day task management.
  • Practical experience with APIs, databases, authentication and reliable error handling for integrations and automations.
  • Testing, deployment and production debugging skills, and the ability to verify AI-generated code and results.
  • Clear written and spoken English for day-to-day collaboration.

C#/.NET, DATEV integration experience and German are helpful.

How we work

You work directly with the founders and the team. We provide business context and agree on goals and priorities. You take ownership of reaching them, communicate progress and use your judgment about when to proceed and when a decision needs discussion.

Compensation

Gross annual salary: â¬72,000â90,000, depending on experience. Full-time contractors are also welcome.

Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.

 

Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patientsâ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability.

 

Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabsâ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone.


About the role: 

We are currently seeking a full-time Field Phlebotomy Supervisor interested in joining a high-growth stage startup. The mandate of the Field Phlebotomy Supervisor is simple but challenging: assist our Operations Manager with the day-to-day operations throughout the market and ensure our patients have the best experience possible.

 

The Field Phlebotomy Supervisor oversees the quality of territories patient operations. You will be responsible for ensuring that every Getlabs experience meets and exceeds the patient's expectations. You will also help train and ensure quality for our team of hourly phlebotomists.  Above all, we are seeking candidates who are self-starters and are resourceful, organized, detail-oriented, communicative, and friendly.

 

This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a one-hour commute of the San Francisco Bay Area. 

 

 

 

 

\n


At Getlabs, you will:
  • Supervise a team of mobile phlebotomists in one or more geographical markets
  • Assess work performance and perform appointment reviews for compliance, quality, and safety on a regular basis; accurately report all findings
  • Administer disciplinary action as appropriate
  • Interview and hire new mobile phlebotomists
  • Effectively and efficiently onboard new hires
  • Complete new hire and annual competency assessments for team
  • Ensure accurate order and patient appointment record-keeping 
  • Administer performance reviewsHandle employee concerns and grievances
  • Review daily/weekly schedules for team and make schedule adjustments as needed; organize, plan, and assign work
  • Plan and manage a budget
  • Assist with day-to-day customer service and manager-level escalations including interactions with patients via inbound calls, outbound calls, emails, and other communication platforms
  • Review and approve team timecards and expenses 


What we are looking for:
  • At least 2 years of management experience in a leadership position is required
  • Phlebotomy certification from an accredited agency is required: American Medical Technologists (AMT), American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT) In-depth knowledge of phlebotomy duties, responsibilities and techniques a plus!
  • Proven track record in providing exceptional customer service
  • Strong communication skills; both written and verbal (Google suite a plus)
  • A disciplined worker who can work independently or in a team environment
  • Reliable transportation and clean driving record
  • Competency with Google applications and willingness to embrace new technology
  • A proven ability to handle ambiguity in the absence of defined systems and processes


We have great benefits to make your life easier so you can focus on what you're best at:
  • Competitive annual salary ranging $95,000-$105,000
  • Valuable stock option plan
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance options
  • Flexible and unlimited vacation
  • A company with a huge vision, a dynamic work environment, and a team of talented, ambitious and fun to work-with colleagues!


\n

The health and safety of our employees and their families is our top priority. Due to the ongoing nature of the COVID-19 pandemic we have decided to require vaccination as a condition of employment for any employee who is in contact with patients.

 

Getlabs is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or other protected classes.

About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.
